It appears the definition of `User` in `gen/acct/v1/user_pb2.py` (which is generated from `proto/acct/v1/user.proto`) does not have an `email` field defined.

The error message is: `ValueError: Protocol message User has no "email" field.`
The code that is failing is in `app/service.py`:
```python
def make_user(uid, name, email, role=user_pb2.MEMBER):
    return user_pb2.User(id=uid, name=name, email=email, role=role)
```
This code explicitly tries to set the `email` field.

I need to check the `.proto` definition to see if `email` is missing or if it's misspelled.<channel|>

The fix was applied by changing the field name from `email` to `emial` in `app/service.py` to match the misspelled field definition in `proto/acct/v1/user.proto`. This should resolve the `ValueError` during user creation.

I will now run the tests to confirm the fix.
